title: Abort M6 goals when Skill execution fails
goal: Convert non-cancellation Skill boundary failures into failed observations so M6 evaluates and authoritatively aborts the goal instead of leaking an exception and leaving the goal active.
context: M6Orchestrator catches ModuleRuntime failures but lets SkillExecutionBoundary errors escape. In addition, its answer-only projection treats any proposal without a toolID as answer-only, including Skill proposals, allowing the reasoning answer to overwrite the failure reason.
forbidden_changes: Do not turn Skill execution errors into successful receipts or answers.
Do not swallow CancellationError or ModuleRuntimeError.cancelled.
Do not change policy authorization, capability grants, or Skill verification.
acceptance_criteria: A non-cancellation Skill boundary error produces a failed observation with verified=false and succeeded=false.
M6 evaluates the failed observation, returns abort, and updates the goal to aborted.
Skill proposals are excluded from answer-only reasoning projection.
Cancellation still propagates rather than being converted into ordinary failure.
Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
verification: Confirm Agent Task Contract, M3, and Apple Native Build & Unsigned IPA pass on the final PR head.
recovery: If the regression fails, preserve cancellation propagation, record failed Skill execution as a failed Observation, and verify the authoritative goal StateUpdate.
